name: leased-daemon-instances
description: Credential-free Tier-P source proof for cross-root daemon attribution, owner renewal, hard expiry, abrupt owner loss, and installer reclamation that preserves production instances and unrelated proof files.

config.CR_DAEMON_SOURCE_ROOT: Candidate source mounted read-only; defaults to CR_HARNESS_MOUNT or /harness.
config.CR_DAEMON_NATIVE_HELPER_ROOT: Prebuilt helper bundle containing daemon_instances.sh and native/linux-ARCH/daemon-instance.
config.CR_DAEMON_SOURCE_BUILD: Set to 1 only to select explicit native source construction in a build-toolchain image; never a daemon-startup fallback.

stages.title: real instance lifetime and installer cleanup
